admission.justification: Realized across six MCP server modules and four test suites and guarded by an AST repository scan, preventing private SDK attribute coupling that silently breaks across mcp 2.x upgrades.

applicability: All repository Python code under mcp/src, mcp/test_support, scripts, and mcp/tests that interacts with the mcp 2.3.0 SDK.
conditions: Production tool registration, listing, dispatch, role narrowing, schema compaction, structured output conversion, and extension queries use public MCPServer, ToolAnnotations, SkipJsonSchema, mcp.Client, and public typing/pydantic APIs.
Protocol timeout and choke-point tests patch public MCPServer.list_tools and MCPServer.call_tool rather than private server attributes.
exclusions: Provisional ServerMiddleware from mcp.server.context used strictly on initialize in preserve_handshake_extensions, which is tracked separately by a decision record and touches no private SDK attribute.

evidence: Clean freeze copy /var/tmp/agents-remember/ar-003952a772f3/freeze-r1 (tree 651dd79f9632829ea86d6ab2a3afbc33b9d227c9): sh .githooks/_gate.sh fast PASS; 21-file focused pytest 213 passed, 134 subtests passed; scratch/worker/d625d7c6-fcc9-51fc-9c6b-c09a8b320b3a/evidence4-private-sdk-scan.json (2622 files scanned, 0 AST hits, 0 non-guard regex hits).

statement: The tool server, test support, scripts, and tests reach the mcp 2.3.0 SDK exclusively through documented public APIs without accessing private SDK attributes or internal SDK module paths.
title: Tool server and tests reach mcp 2.3.0 SDK only through public APIs
